title: SCI-AGENT-EXAM: Benchmarking Agents on Scientific Research Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.32441v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of supporting scientific workflows, but their capabilities across diverse research activities remain difficult to assess systematically. Existing benchmarks often focus on selected scientific capabilities or task types, limiting a comprehensive characterization of scientific agents' strengths and weaknesses in realistic research workflows. We introduce SCI-AGENT-EXAM, a workflow-oriented benchmark comprising 120 expert-curated tasks across 11 scientific fields and 7 research task types defined by the Scientific Workflow Task Taxonomy (SWTT). Each task requires both executable artifacts (e.g., code and scripts) and textual artifacts (e.g., reports and explanations). To evaluate the heterogeneous task outputs, we develop a hybrid evaluation protocol combining deterministic programmatic verification for executable artifacts with a calibrated, expert-validated LLM-based judge for tex

translated_title: SCI-AGENT-EXAM：面向科研任务的智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在支持科学工作流程方面的能力日益增强，但它们在多样化科研活动中的能力仍难以进行系统性评估。现有基准测试往往只关注特定的科学能力或任务类型，限制了对科研智能体在真实研究工作流程中优劣势的全面刻画。我们提出了SCI-AGENT-EXAM，这是一个面向工作流程的基准测试，包含120个由专家精心策划的任务，涵盖11个科学领域以及由科学工作流程任务分类法（SWTT）定义的7种研究任务类型。每个任务同时需要可执行的产物（如代码和脚本）和文本产物（如报告和解释）。为了评估这些异构的任务输出，我们开发了一种混合评估协议，将针对可执行产物的确定性程序化验证与经过校准、由专家验证的基于大语言模型的评判器相结合，用于评估文本产物。
tldr: 提出了SCI-AGENT-EXAM基准测试，包含120个覆盖11个科学领域和7种任务类型的专家设计任务，并采用程序化验证与LLM评判相结合的混合评估协议，以系统评估科研智能体在真实研究工作流程中的综合能力。
en_tdlr: SCI-AGENT-EXAM is a workflow-oriented benchmark of 120 expert-curated tasks across 11 scientific fields and 7 research task types, featuring a hybrid evaluation protocol that combines deterministic programmatic verification with a calibrated LLM-based judge to systematically assess scientific agents' capabilities in realistic research workflows.
